_comment: Shape reference for highlights.json. This file is not rendered anywhere.
Order in the array is display order, top to bottom.
imageSide flips the figure between the left and right column.
imageColumn/textColumn are Bulma column widths and should complement each
imageRatio is any Bulma figure ratio: is-3by2, is-4by3, is-16by9, is-9by16.
'summary' and 'citation' may contain raw HTML - they are output with | safe.
title: Short descriptive title of the highlight
summary: A paragraph of plain-language summary. May contain markup.
citation: <u>Author A</u>, Author B. 2025. Title of the paper. Journal 1:1-10.
alt: Description of what the figure shows
